nodes.label: Bluetooth HID session teardown (BlueZ send buffer overrun)
nodes.norm_label: bluetooth hid session teardown (bluez send buffer overrun)
nodes.rationale: BlueZ destroys the kernel HID device after its L2CAP send buffer overruns while ACL link and pairing survive; daemon paces output to 40 Hz (BtOutputPacer) to stay under the limit.

nodes.label: Shared ipc-client compiled from src/
nodes.rationale: Compiled into the UI instead of duplicated so UI and ds4-ctl share one protocol client.

nodes.label: Per-file strict warnings
nodes.rationale: UI talks to a privileged daemon, so -Werror applies per source file, not the target, because moc/qmlcachegen generated code fails -Werror.

nodes.label: hid-generic swap
nodes.rationale: Moves the BT pad off hid-playstation to avoid its battery/LED/FF devices while HID-BPF still has a bound driver; requires temporarily raising global ignore_special_drivers.

nodes.label: Hide methods (legacy/unbind/unlink)
nodes.rationale: Bluetooth hid_device is created by bluetoothd writing into /dev/uhid, so the driver cannot be unbound like USB; unbind neutralizes nodes, unlink removes them.

nodes.label: MAC squat
nodes.rationale: Emulated device takes the physical pad's MAC so hid-playstation refuses the real pad (duplicate MAC), preventing battery/LED registration; trade-off is a controller visible whenever daemon runs.

nodes.norm_label: hid-bpf hid_device_event swallow and ringbuf mirror

nodes.label: hid_rdesc_fixup kernel crash
nodes.rationale: Zeroing the report descriptor to one byte caused a NULL deref in the kernel HID-BPF dispatcher and wedged bluetoothd; only hid_device_event is implemented now.

nodes.label: Backend selection (uhid vs functionfs)
nodes.rationale: uhid skips real USB enumeration, so some Wine/Proton titles never detect an emulated DS4; functionfs gives a real enumeration handshake and fixes it. DS4 defaults to functionfs, DualSense to uhid.

nodes.label: Single pkexec root helper
nodes.rationale: One polkit prompt per run; helper accepts only argv lists, no shell strings, no sudo fallback.

nodes.label: Haptics rumble heuristic
nodes.rationale: On a DS4 the heavy ERM motor overpowers the light one when both are driven under haptics select, so the heavy motor is muted.

nodes.label: hid-ds4-translator kernel module (Option A binder)
nodes.rationale: Binding the pad before hid-playstation removes the source of all hide workarounds; Option A chosen because translation costs only microseconds so in-kernel translation (B, C) adds crash risk without latency gain.

nodes.label: Stick and trigger calibration (ds4-tools)
nodes.rationale: ds4-tools warns these commands can brick a controller; default to temporary flash mode and refuse over Bluetooth until verified.

nodes.label: Package signing with release subkey
nodes.rationale: Only the signing subkey is stored in CI so a leak can be revoked without changing the trusted primary key.
